lines.en: I knock on Futaba’s door and the video game breaks.

The theme for a girl I have yet to meet slips down the holes inside of my head called “ears” and works its way throughout my body, getting caught on a variety of hairs and other things you typically find in bodies.
I knock again because Futaba is glitched and I must brute force Lessons in Love back into doing what I want it to do.
No matter how many times I knock, though, she remains tucked in the corner behind a circular shadow, staring at the wall and waiting for its paper to wrap around her.
I long to wrap myself around her the way she wishes the paper would but, unfortunately, that will not be an option I have until later.
A GIFT RAINS DOWN UPON YOU
YOU HAVE RECEIVED AN [[incomplete Futaba]
: Let’s party!
: I don’t want to party. I am here to check on your writing assignment and learn more about why you avoid mirrors.
: Leeeeeet’s party!
: Futaba, stop it. And tell your T-posing clone to go away too.
: Let’s party!
: Ugh...
Welp, looks like it’s going to be another hectic night for me.
And here I was thinking Futaba was exempt from duplicating or getting caught in glitches.
: Let’s-
: Shut the fuck up for a second. I don’t want to party and I’m trying to make the game go back to normal.
: Party now! Party now! Party now!

I begrudgingly remove a collapsible party hat from my back pocket and stick it on top of my head, hoping that its juices quickly dissolve into my skull because I really don’t have time for this right now.
: Your story-
: YOU WORRY TOO MUCH ABOUT THE STORY.
: WE NEED TO HAVE FUN SOMETIMES TOO, SENSEI!
: ISN’T THE FUN OVERDUE, SENSEI?!
: DON’T YOU WANT TO TOUCH MY FAT FUCKING TITS, SENSEI?
: Futaba, please. Not at the party.
: DO IT. DO IT, YOU FUCKING WORM.
: I’M NOT SCARED. I’M READY.
: MY AFFINITY FOR YOU GROWS LIKE A REDWOOD AND YET YOU SIT IDLY BY AND WATCH.
: YOU FAVOR ME.
: YOU FAVOR ME WHEN YOU KNOW I WILL DO ANYTHING TO MAKE YOU LIKE ME.
: PEEL AWAY THE THIN LAYERS OF FABRIC THAT COVER THE PARTS OF ME I HAVE SAVED FOR YOU.
: PLUCK MY PETALS.
My pants suddenly tighten but I’m worried about making any moves due to the extra Futaba still hanging out in the corner of the room, even if her head is now obscured by a fun party banner.
When I blink, it all disappears and I realize that no time has passed at all.
I should probably knock on Futaba’s door because that is why I am here.
: Sensei?
: Hello.
: Is...everything okay? I thought I heard someone outside of the door, but...I figured it was just Miku trying to mess with me again.
: Were you...about to knock? Or are you just passing by?
: This isn’t really a place I can just “pass by.” And besides, I did knock. A bunch of times, actually.
: You did? I’m so sorry then...I must not have heard.
: DON’T LET IT HAPPEN AGAIN, YOU FUCKING CUNT It’s fine. Don’t worry about it.
: Hey, are you doing anything right now?
: Right now? No...I was about to go take a shower, but...I suppose I can wait until you’re gone.
: Great. Do you want to go somewhere darker with me?
: Umm...darker?
: Somewhere far away.
: I can’t be here right now.
: Sensei...if you want to talk about something, I-
: Are you coming or not?
Futaba thinks long and hard about whether or not she wants to put her faith into a man who would trade it all away for a mouth to cum inside of.
In several seconds, she will make the wrong decision.
And the two of us will embark on a hot, sweaty journey across this make-believe world together.
: We can go wherever you’d like...
That’s right.
We can go wherever I’d like.
None of this is real.
Anything that I have convinced myself I’ve felt as of late is nothing short of cowardice.
Futaba Fukuyama is a naive teenage girl who is doing her best to appeal to me in ways deeper than her skin, but her skin alone is what I want.
I want the scent of lavender to stain my bedsheets.
I want my skin underneath her fingernails.
I want her.
I want her I want her I want her I want her.
And that is exactly why I can’t be here right now.
Because if the two of us remained here, I would take her with the minimal amount of force I am sure it would require.
I lead her out into the night in an attempt to mask my shadow with something darker.
She follows suit, blushing and bouncing.
We end up somewhere not at all familiar to me.
I don’t know how long it took the two of us to get here or the space between where we stand right now and where Futaba will rest her head tonight...
But I’m not too worried.
Because the uncertainties inside of me have managed to fade like the dull colors of the traffic lights around us, incessantly cycling between “go” and “stop” and not offering anything in between.
It reminds me a little of myself, but not in a good way.
Lately, I have found myself getting so caught up in the depths of my mind that, sometimes, I’m shocked I’m able to crawl out at all.
I never know when it’s happening.
In fact, a lot of the time, I don’t even know when it’s over.
But when everything about this life is still a blur to me, even now, I can’t help but come unglued.
What is real?
What is not?
And what substance is being used to keep me grounded? Because it is very clearly not working if I’ve managed to make even Futaba uncomfortable tonight.
: Can I ask you something, Futaba?
: Of course. Though...it’s a little worrying to have you ask to ask me rather than just ask me outright.
: Are you scared of me?
: Scared?
: This isn’t normal...Coming to your room in the middle of the night and standing outside your door...Dragging you with me to some part of town I’ve never even seen before...
: And all for nothing, too.
: It’s not nothing, Sensei. You didn’t want to be in the dorms, right?
: And I’m assuming...you didn’t want to be at home either.
: I don’t know if I’m just the lucky one who managed to open her door and find you first tonight, but...
: I’m not scared of you.
: Well, you should be.
: Why do you say that?
: I don’t know.
: I just think that you’re supposed to be scared of me.
: Hmm...Well, I don’t think that’s a very compelling reason. So I think I’ll just remain unafraid, if that’s okay with you.
: What will it take to make you scared of me?
: You’re starting to sound like you want me to be scared of you.
: I...don’t think that’s the case.
: I just don’t understand why you...or anyone else for the matter, is just okay with me doing the things I do when they’re so clearly wrong.
: I think...the answer to that might be a little more boring than you expect, Sensei.
: We simply...don’t think the things you do are wrong.
: Then you’re all just as lost as I am.
: Maybe we are...
: But we trust and respect our guide.
: And...I may not be able to speak for anyone else...but I don’t think that part of me will ever change.
: I might not be the type of heroine you’d enjoy to read about in a story, Sensei...
: But...
: I think I make a pretty good supporting character.
: And I’ll support you in any way you want...because that’s how much I trust you.
: You’re making a mistake.
: Heheh~
: We’ll see about that...
We make our way up the incline and disappear down an alleyway because even the light of the moon is too bright for me to properly hide right now.

I don’t understand Futaba at all. I don’t understand why she’s okay with me or why she’d even go as far as calling me her guide when I am merely one dark passage away from stealing something precious to her.
There are no cars this late at night. None near us at least.
Everything is perfectly silent apart from Futaba’s boots making contact with the ground.
It gets colder as we get higher.
I haven’t felt a chill like this in a long time.
: Huh...I think we’re actually getting kind of close to one of the edges of Kumon-mi...
: We’re not in some sort of...restricted area or something, are we?
: Have you never seen the barrier up close before, Sensei?
: I went with a friend of mine once. We wrote our given names on the wall just last year...right before I started high school.
: Is this the same friend I’ve heard you talk about before?
: It is. And it’s probably safe to assume she’s the one I’m talking about whenever I don’t say “Rin,” since those two are basically my only good friends.
: Unfortunately, the part we wrote on is miles away from here. And, honestly, I don’t even know if I’d be able to find it or if...these walls are ever cleaned.
: Should we write our names on the wall as well?
: Maybe. Come to think of it...I don’t even know your real name.
: I’d just write “Sensei” anyway. As far as I’m concerned, that is my name.
: Do you really want to go? It’s really big up close. But I guess that’s to be expected since the whole point is to isolate us in the first place.
: Not to be a downer, but a trip to a giant wall doesn’t sound like much fun. I was just kidding about writing our names down anyway.
: I guess I’m just a little gullible then.
: But, um...if we’re not going to keep going until we reach the end...would you mind if we took a little break soon?
: It goes without saying, but...I’m not really...um...one of the fittest girls in the class and...we’ve been walking for a while now.
: Sure. We’ll stop at the next bench we see and head back home after that.
: Are you okay with that? Going home, I mean.
: Of course. I’m completely fine.
: I just felt like walking tonight...and what better place to walk than some random, dimly lit area near a giant wall?
: Heheh...right. What better place indeed.
Alley after alley, light after light...our journey continues and somehow manages to grow even colder than I had mentioned it being just moments ago.
I guess that even summer has nights like that.
Despite the drop in temperature, I am never once tempted to reach for Futaba’s hand and warm it using my own.
I’m tempted to do plenty of other things of course...and perhaps I even would if it were not for the infectious smile that she’s yet to abandon even once since setting out into the night with me.
Maybe I do want her to fear me?
Maybe the fear is what compels me to act at all?
And maybe, if I can wipe that smile off of her face-
I can spare her from the agony I am sure she will endure because of me.
Maybe not tonight.
Maybe not the next.
But one day, everything around her will come crashing down.
And chances are...when she looks up...I will be towering over her and the remnants of all that she loves.
With a hammer in one hand-
And the base of my cock in the other.
: Umm...forgive me for asking this, but...have you been intentionally looking away from me all night? Or is that just...happening on accident?
: I haven’t really been thinking about it.
: I see...
: You...
: You can look at me, you know?...
I turn to look at Futaba.
But she melts into a puddle of goat’s milk that I can’t help but lap up with my clam’s tongue.
: There...don’t you think it’s easier to have a conversation when we’re both looking at each other?
No.
: Now...is there anything you want to talk to me about, Sensei?
No.
: Is there...anything you want me to talk to you about?
No.
No no no no no.
: Is there...
: Anything you want to me to do to you?
Yes.
: Is something wrong?
: I can’t tell if what I just heard was actually real or not.
: What did you hear, exactly?
: Something that if I didn’t hear and said out loud would cause a lot of problems for both of us.
: Then...
: I guess you heard correctly.
: U-Unless I...completely misunderstood something!
: Which, knowing me and my...no experience with boys...is extremely possible...
: If that’s the case...please forget that I said anything and...please forget how extremely inappropriate it would be for me to even suggest that-
: Futaba.
: Um...Y...Yeah?
: Are you sure?
: I want to do everything I can to make you feel better, Sensei...
: And if you’re not the type who wants to talk about problems...
: Maybe I can...make you feel better in other ways?
: After all, it’s...it’s not like I haven’t been thinking about that kind of stuff.
: In fact...ever since you...admitted to being...a...aroused by me in my room...I’ve had trouble...not thinking about it.
: Would...something like that actually make you happy, Sensei?...
: Yes.
I lie as if it’s second nature, disguising my true feelings with yet another glance in the opposite direction.
That must be the thousandth tonight.
Futaba does not say anything after that. She simply nods- like she’s accepting a task as standard as cleaning the chalkboard or taking out the trash.
She books us a ride back to the dorm on her phone, using money her parents sent her so she can perform a sexual favor for her teacher in the comfort of her own room.
I’m sure they would be proud.
The car arrives- it’s the first one I’ve seen tonight.
When the two of us get inside, I sit closer to her than I did on the bench.
I reach for her hand while she’s not looking and place it in my lap.
She jumps, but understands what I want.
What she doesn’t understand is that it won’t make me happy.
It will just make me a little less numb.
Futaba’s affection has increased to [futaba_love]!
